subject: A Kenya–Tanzania safari now carries two US$44 insurance charges, and every government that added a cost this week added it at the border
preview: The seams between destinations changed this week.

big_reads.title: The world's biggest travel market is going farther and paying less. East Africa built the opposite product.
East Africa sells twelve nights. Its own arrivals data says most visitors want three.
Kenya just won Africa's visa argument. Its own arrivals data says the border was never the barrier.
Google stopped filling in your rate in September. East Africa's number now comes from the OTA.
Kenya has one Ebola case and two contagions. Only one of them is a virus.
Europe spent six years learning to count its beds. Kenya is proposing to abolish the office that counts.
Three central banks held their rates this week. The number that decides whether your lodge gets built was not one of them.
